mapper.select:
SELECT ss.* FROM service_schedule ss INNER JOIN service_member sm ON ss.member_id = sm.id WHERE ss.date = #{date} AND TRIM(IFNULL(ss.time_slot, '')) = TRIM(IFNULL(#{timeSlot}, '')) AND sm.service_type = #{serviceType} AND (ss.reserved_count IS NULL OR ss.reserved_count < IFNULL(ss.max_capacity, 1)) AND ss.status = '可预约' AND sm.status = 1
AND (ss.store_id = #{storeId} OR (ss.store_id IS NULL AND sm.store_id = #{storeId}))
ORDER BY sm.rating DESC, sm.total_tasks ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE service_schedule SET status = '不可预约', task_id = #{taskId}, reserved_count = LEAST(IFNULL(reserved_count, 0) + 1, IFNULL(max_capacity, 1)), is_available = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = '可预约'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM service_schedule WHERE service_type = #{serviceType} AND date = #{date} AND (is_available IS NULL OR is_available = 1) AND status = '可预约' AND (reserved_count IS NULL OR reserved_count < max_capacity) ORDER BY time_slot ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE service_schedule SET status = #{status}, task_id = #{taskId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
